prompt:
# Decorative prop d10077: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10077/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the full-length very slim dark shaft, repeated diagonal orange-gold wrap, small gold diamond fittings, pale stud accents, silver-white top cap, and tiny lower fitting. Render one complete Tournament Staff on genuine transparent RGBA..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the full-length very slim dark shaft, repeated diagonal orange-gold wrap, small gold diamond fittings, pale stud accents, silver-white top cap, and tiny lower fitting. Render one complete Tournament Staff on genuine transparent RGBA.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10077/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the immutable edit target; 2 design_reference.png is appearance reference; 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference. Output 1536x2048. Preserve all ten tiny/slim guide silhouettes at identical coordinates. End-on views remain tiny circular end caps. Do not enlarge the staff widths for readability. Orange-gold leather bindings use GREEN in material masks; wooden shaft YELLOW; metal studs, diamonds and caps RED. No visible grid.
CORRECTION: Previous attempt widened the rods and added stray coloured wisps. Strictly retain the guide alpha silhouettes, extremely thin smooth rods (approximately 14 pixels wide for 445 pixels long on the 1536x2048 guide). Paint only within existing guide alpha. NO wisps, no ornaments extending beyond guide, no coloured pixels outside. The silhouette is more important than rendering detail. Material masks must have clean straight boundaries with only exact pure solid palette colours. Match original guide positions and slender width exactly.
validation: Layout retained, but silhouette overflow and non-flat mask colours remain; raw output preserved without postprocessing.
